| description = A common newbie mob found in [[Butcherblock Mountains]] near Kaladim and around the zone, and in many other zones. Not poisonous.

They are not aggressive, and do not socialize, making they and their relatives excellent hunting for the lower levels[https://web.archive.org/web/20011113014913/http://eqbeastiary.allakhazam.com:80/search.shtml?id=172].
